statement: 7 Further work We leave open the question of quantitative refinements of our decidability results. These include giving complexity upper bounds for the Non-negative and Positive Membership Problems as well as the related question of giving upper bounds on the length of the shortest string of generators that yields a non-negative or positive matrix in a given semigroup. Both questions would seem to be difficult owing to the use of Schanuel’s Conjecture in our proofs. Characterising the complexity of determining whether a matrix is eventually non-negative would seem to be more straightforward. We claim that the decision procedure can be implemented in non-deterministic polynomial time. Note that the analogous Eventual Positivity problem is in PTIME [18].
